response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS st, sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) AS r FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE si.healtheval IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT st, AVG(r) AS a, COUNT(r) AS n FROM s GROUP BY st HAVING COUNT(r) > 0), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS oa FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.n) AS avg_count, AVG(g.a - o.oa) AS avg_excess FROM g, o WHERE g.a > o.oa

assumptions.assumption: A status's rate is the mean of the per-scan gbsize/spanmin ratios. Scans with a missing gbsize or spanmin, or a zero spanmin (which gives NULL), are ignored.
The all-status average is the unweighted mean of the per-status average rates, so each status counts once regardless of how many scans it has.
Scans whose site has a NULL healtheval are excluded, since NULL is not a status. Statuses with no valid rate are also excluded.
'Average count' means the average number of scans with a valid rate across the qualifying statuses.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-status average is the pooled average of every valid scan ratio across all statuses (scan-weighted), not the mean of status averages.
